storage.built_in: OS on 2 x M.2 SSDs (RAID 1); recording HDDs by model: 320 TB (20 x 16 TB), 400 TB (20 x 20 TB)

features: Preloaded Video Insight software with VI Enterprise Server activation
Recommended recording rate: 300-600 Mbps on a 1 Gbps network, 600-1100 Mbps on a 10 Gbps network
Network: 2 x 1 GbE BASE-T and 2 x 10 GbE SFP+
notes: Datasheet gives Storage RAID 6 under HDD bays and RAID 5 on the RAID controller line; RAID level left out.
